analysis_metadata.title: Polarix STUCK_VALUE Anomaly Classification Investigation & Refinement
analysis_metadata.scope: Deterministic downstream STUCK_VALUE classification analysis and active-tail flatline rule refinement

original_limitation_and_root_cause.lstm_reconstruction_limitation: Neural sequence autoencoders easily reconstruct flatline/constant vectors with near-zero MSE reconstruction loss (often < 1e-4), causing primary reconstruction threshold detectors to assign status=NORMAL for unshifted flatlines.
original_limitation_and_root_cause.downstream_classifier_gap: Previous classifier rules evaluated max_consecutive_near_stuck across the entire 30-step window, which caused false STUCK_VALUE classifications on recovered observations where a historical flatline existed in past history (indices 0..15) but active variation had resumed at the current tail (indices 15..29).
original_limitation_and_root_cause.solution: Refined the deterministic physical classification rule to require active flatline at the sequence tail (tail_consecutive_stuck >= 8, or tail_std_10 <= 1e-4 with tail_run >= 6, or entire window variance <= 1e-4), distinguishing active freeze from historical recovery.

features_used: tail_consecutive_stuck (consecutive observations ending at arr[-1] with step delta <= 1e-4)
tail_std_10 (sample standard deviation of the last 10 observations)
std (overall standard deviation across full 30-step window)
max_consecutive_near_stuck (longest run of consecutive near-identical points in window)
refined_rule_specification.decision_logic: STUCK_VALUE if: (tail_consecutive_stuck >= 8) OR (tail_std_10 <= 1e-4 AND tail_consecutive_stuck >= 6) OR (std <= 1e-4 AND max_consecutive_near_stuck >= 20)
refined_rule_specification.recovery_behavior: When a sensor was stuck historically but resumes active variance at tail (tail_std_10 > 1e-4, tail_consecutive_stuck < 5), STUCK_VALUE is not triggered, correctly classifying current observation as NORMAL/UNKNOWN based on primary detector.

frozen_artifact_status.statement: All 8 frozen neural network models, scalers, configs, and decision thresholds remain 100% untouched and cryptographically verified.
